description: Reword a hand test of the claimed Goal, change which Task it is about, or remove it with an empty text (for one that turned out not to need testing). Its mark from the Developer stays; only the Developer marks tests.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

id.description: The hand test ID, such as 'h2'.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about; an empty string removes the link.

text.description: The new wording; empty to remove the hand test.

name: update_hand_test
title: Update hand test
